nom: Origins Mini Original Skin Retexturizing Mask

avis.texte: I have been using this mask since 2011 and I am thrilled with the new updated version. I use it once a week, it helps even my skin texture and pushes out my black head. I can’t live without it, highly recommended to anyone who has combination or even dry skin and needs a good cleanse once a week!

I am really enjoying this mask! I use it on my t-zone and I have been having great results minimizing my pores! Nice refreshing smell and feel when put on. Bottle is small, however since I only use on parts of my face, should last awhile using twice a week or less.
Great mask! Forgot how much I love Origins. Cleared up my face, little bumps and left my skin sooo soft. Definitely going to use at least twice a week. Smells great too

I came in here to change my review from 3 to 4 stars because, while it’s not as good as their rose pink one, and despite still believing it’s a bit overpriced for its size ($36/2.5oz)… I managed to get my fiance to put a little bit along his t-zone (he doesn’t like stuff on his face, so that was a big step 😂), and it really worked wonders. He’s always had beautiful skin, but summers down here are hot as h*ll and oily skin feels sort of inevitable. I will probably purchase again at the smaller size, but not as my go-to resurfacing mask.

I have had a hard time finding good facial masks. Others esp cheaper brands, burn, dry out, or make you more oily etc. But this brand is my go to now. May be a little pricey for the larger size but it makes my skin look good.

avis.titre: Works well just not as good as their red clay
avis.texte: I like it - took one star off because I was trying to find their red clay mask

avis.titre: It's a rose of a mask
avis.texte: This is one of my favorite mask. Ive been using for years. Once you apply, you wait about 10 minutes for it to completly dry. You can feel your the mask tightening up over your skin. A little goes a long way so you don't need to use a lot and it gives nice hydration to your skin. It does have a light rose smell. Normally I dont tolerate smells easily but don't have a problem with this one.
It’s a good mask and I recommend it. It leaves the skin soft and fresh afterwards

Great mask! Some tingling when i apppy (may noy be great for sensitive skin) but helps qith pores, blackhead and fading away my acne scars. Little drying after use but easy to resolve with moisturizer

The Origins Original Skin Retexturizing Mask delivers a refreshing and effective skincare experience. The combination of clay and jojoba beads works to visibly minimize pores and refine skin texture, leaving my complexion feeling smoother and more balanced. With just 10 minutes, it provides a quick yet noticeable boost, and I haven’t experienced any negative skin interactions. Great for normal, oily, and combination skin, it’s a reliable pick for a gentle yet powerful reset.

Love this mask! It has good texture, smells pleasant, my skin felt refreshed and smooth after using it. My pores seemed tighter, which is great! I use mineral sunscreen daily, it’s so hard to wash off, so this mask is perfect for my suffocating pores! 10 out of 10!

avis.titre: Makes my skin soft and happy
avis.texte: This mask itself comes in a minimalist, sage green tube and has a medium-thick clay texture with small exfoliating beads and a very pale rose pink color. It has a mild scent that seems identical to the Origins charcoal mask (sort of a cross between lemongrass and bamboo) that disappears when the mask is washed off. Applying it was easy; it only required me to use my fingers. Dispensing it was easy since it's in a squeeze tube. This a purifying and exfoliating mask, but gentler than the Origins charcoal mask. Typically, clay masks are very drying on my skin, though sometimes it can be worth it if I use it sparingly enough. This one though, is a bit different; I don't feel dry and tight (I do for a couple minutes and then it goes away), instead my skin feels refreshed and looks like I just had a facial. As it dries it firms up and hardens but doesn't feel like you're wearing a layer of rock on your face. Rinsing clay masks off can be a pain (for me, anyway, especially if I'm just rinsing over the sink instead of in the shower), but this one rinsed off fairly easily and and the jojoba beads did a nice gentle exfoliating scrub. When my skin was rinsed and dried, my skin felt great and looked fresh and clean. My sensitive skin experienced some very subtle singing while wearing the mask, but the feeling disappeared after rinsing, and I liked the way it left me feeling. avis.titre: Fresh fragrance, smooth and tone skin, like having a facial.
avis.texte: Origins Retexturizing Mask... 📚Pros: Easy to apply, easy to wash off. 100% vegan. 📚Cons: None. 📚Summary: Feels good as it's drying, almost as though you can feel it drawing out impurities and tightening or smoothing. The mask has a fresh fragrance, and I love the texture with the Jojoba beads. Once I rinsed it off my skin looked smooth and tighter, felt as though I had had a facial. Good skin care is good self care and I love including this one in my weekly mask and skin care routine 👍👍
